details:
Hello!

I’d like to suggest adding Asturian (Asturianu) as a selectable language in VRChat profiles.

Asturian is a language spoken in Asturias, a region in the north of Spain. Even though it’s not an official language at the national level, it is officially recognized and protected, taught in schools, and actively used in everyday life, media, and local culture.

More info about the language:

https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idioma_asturiano

Although Asturias is a relatively small region, Asturian is widely spoken or at least understood across the whole region, and many people naturally mix it into daily conversations. There’s also a community of Asturian speakers using VRChat who would love to be able to represent their language properly.

Adding Asturian as a profile language would help:

Give visibility to a minority but living language

Help people connect through shared language and culture

Support cultural and linguistic diversity within VRChat

I’d also like to add that I’d be willing to help contribute to an Asturian interface translation in the future if VRChat ever decides to support it, similar to how other games and platforms already include Asturian thanks to community contributions.

Thanks for reading!!
title: Add Asturian (Asturianu) as a Profile Language
